reason: The cited evidence shows that machine-learned potentials can be trained on ab initio liquid data (E2) and that active learning improves configurational coverage (E1), but none of the passages directly support the specific claims about delta-learning on EAM, the magnitude of mismatch reduction, or the applicability to the stated HEA system and conditions.
premises: EAM potentials fail to represent many-body interactions and diverse atomic configurations of the ab initio liquid
A machine-learned correction trained on ab initio liquid data can capture these missing many-body interactions
Adding this correction to EAM improves phase-space overlap with the ab initio target
Improved overlap reduces thermodynamic-integration path mismatch by ~40–50% relative to pure EAM
The approach is valid for equimolar Cr–Fe–Mn–Ni HEA near its melting point (~3000 K)
